sources.fullCitation: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester, with German refrain vocal by L. Monosson. “Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel.” Tango; words by Fritz Rotter; music by Bronisław Kaper. Grammophon B 51043, Bestell-Nr. 23179, side 2, n.d. [not before 1930]. Label visible via Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv online upload.
sources.title: Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel
sources.creator: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester; L. Monosson, vocal refrain

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refrain: Leo Moll. “Signorina aus Brioni.” Tango; label credit “Tango (Fritz Rotter und Dr. Kaper); Text: Fritz Rotter und Dr. Kaper”. Electrola, Katalog-Nr. E.G. 2400, n.d. The label also carries the B.I.E.M. mark and the designation Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang; the uploader identifies the refrain singer billed as Leo Moll as Leo Monosson, gives 1931 as the year of release, and illustrates the transfer with a photograph of Brioni from 1930. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Signorina aus Brioni — Electrola E.G. 2400
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refrain: Leo Moll

media.title: Leo Monosson — signed photographic postcard, Photo C. Wolf, Berlin
media.description: Leo Monosson on a signed photographic postcard, credited in print to “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” and captioned with his name. He sang the refrains on the Grammophon and Electrola recordings of two Kaper songs.
media.altText: Photographic postcard portrait of the singer Leo Monosson in a dark suit, signed across the lower edge.
media.publicCaption: Leo Monosson on a signed photographic postcard, credited in print to “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” and captioned with his name. He sang the refrains on the Grammophon and Electrola recordings of two Kaper songs.
media.publicCreditLine: Photo C. Wolf, Berlin; reproduced by Cabaret Berlin.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The postcard carries the printed credit “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” but no date, and nothing is known of the photographer's death, so no term can be computed and the photograph is treated as protected. The image is displayed at 424 × 611 px, the resolution published by the source, for scholarly identification of a documented performer of Kaper's songs.
